name: compare_databases
description: Compare lookup answers in two loaded databases within a CIDR. Returns paginated added, removed, and changed address ranges. Equal answers with different network boundaries are unchanged.

arguments.name: network
arguments.desc: IPv4 /8 or smaller, or IPv6 /32 or smaller

name: inspect_database
description: Read full MMDB metadata and observe field paths, types, and examples from a bounded sample. The observed fields are not a complete schema.

name: install_database
description: Download and load a database from an HTTP or HTTPS URL. Accepts MMDB, gzip, tar, tar.gz, or ZIP with exactly one MMDB. Downloads and expanded data are limited to 1 GiB. Uses the configured download folder, or the first folder in directory mode. Does not use MaxMind credentials or save the URL for updates.

arguments.name: database
arguments.desc: Destination filename ending in .mmdb, without a directory path.

arguments.name: url
arguments.desc: Database download URL. Requests can reach any HTTP(S) host accessible to this server.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace an existing database with this name. Defaults to false.

name: install_edition
description: Download a MaxMind MMDB edition using configured credentials, load it immediately, and remember it for future updates. The edition need not be in the server configuration. Replaces an existing file for that edition.

arguments.name: edition
arguments.desc: MaxMind edition ID, for example GeoLite2-Country or GeoIP2-Anonymous-IP. Requires account access to that edition.

name: list_databases
description: List available databases, download status, and setup instructions

name: lookup_ip
description: Look up an IP address in one database or all loaded databases

arguments.name: ip
arguments.desc: IP address to lookup

arguments.name: database
arguments.desc: Specific database to query (optional)

arguments.name: fields
arguments.desc: Optional field paths. Returns an object keyed by each selected path. Use dots for map keys, numeric array indexes, or $ for the whole record. Omit or use [] for full records. Repeat on each page.

name: lookup_ips
description: Look up 1 to 100 IP addresses in input order, in one database or all loaded databases. Each result includes its IP and lookup data or an error.

arguments.name: database
arguments.desc: Specific database from list_databases (optional)

arguments.name: fields
arguments.desc: Optional field paths. Returns an object keyed by each selected path. Use dots for map keys, numeric array indexes, or $ for the whole record. Omit or use [] for full records. Repeat on each page.

name: lookup_network
description: Query a CIDR range with optional filters. filters must be an array of objects with keys: field, operator, value. Example: {"field":"traits.user_type","operator":"equals","value":"residential"}. Supported operators: equals, not_equals, in, not_in, contains, regex, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, less_than, less_than_or_equal, exists.

arguments.name: network
arguments.desc: CIDR network to scan (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24')

arguments.name: database
arguments.desc: Database name from list_databases; required when more than one is loaded

arguments.name: fields
arguments.desc: Optional field paths. Returns an object keyed by each selected path. Use dots for map keys, numeric array indexes, or $ for the whole record. Omit or use [] for full records. Repeat on each page.

arguments.name: filter_mode
arguments.desc: How to combine filters: 'and' or 'or' (default: 'and')

arguments.name: filters
arguments.desc: Filters for a new query; omit to keep filters when continuing a query

arguments.name: iterator_id
arguments.desc: Resume existing iterator (fast path)

arguments.name: max_results
arguments.desc: Page size from 1 to 1000

arguments.name: resume_token
arguments.desc: Fallback token if iterator expired

name: lookup_range
description: Query stored network records overlapping an inclusive start/end IP range, with filters, field selection, and pagination. Returns each overlapping network once, not each IP address. Repeat the endpoints on every page.

arguments.name: database
arguments.desc: Database name from list_databases; required when more than one is loaded

arguments.name: fields
arguments.desc: Optional field paths. Returns an object keyed by each selected path. Use dots for map keys, numeric array indexes, or $ for the whole record. Omit or use [] for full records. Repeat on each page.

arguments.name: filter_mode
arguments.desc: How to combine filters: 'and' or 'or' (default: 'and')

arguments.name: filters
arguments.desc: Filters for a new query; omit to keep filters when continuing a query

arguments.name: iterator_id
arguments.desc: Resume existing iterator (fast path)

arguments.name: max_results
arguments.desc: Page size from 1 to 1000

arguments.name: resume_token
arguments.desc: Fallback token if iterator expired

name: summarize_network
description: Group matching records by a scalar field and count records and covered addresses within a CIDR. Limited to 10,000 scanned records and 100 groups. IPv4 aliases are excluded.

arguments.name: group_by
arguments.desc: Field path, array index, or $ for a scalar record. Missing fields form a separate group.

arguments.name: network
arguments.desc: IPv4 /8 or smaller, or IPv6 /32 or smaller

arguments.name: filter_mode
arguments.desc: How to combine filters: 'and' or 'or' (default: 'and')

arguments.name: filters
arguments.desc: Filters for a new query; omit to keep filters when continuing a query

name: update_databases
description: Download and replace configured databases with the latest MaxMind editions

name: verify_database
description: Verify the integrity of a loaded database. Only one verification runs at a time. Cancellation can stop a queued request, but verification runs to completion once started.
